summary_note: Section 5.28. R and C are the same seed, initial model and data schedule with NO forced operation, so the grow/prune mix is drawn; they differ only in whether new experts are freshly drawn (R) or cloned from their layer's busiest survivor (C). *_own are each fused run's own final genome retrained, so R_own-R and C_own-C are the two penalties. Unlike the forced blocks, identical final genomes are NOT asserted - a drawn prune that the genome cannot perform falls back to a load-based grow, which reads the weights - so the divergence count is recorded and each penalty uses its own reference. Negative means the first-named run won.
